answer: The marble report publishes the merge explicitly at each garden. Each collapsed cluster gets one copper weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 67 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 269 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3951 identities would post 3741 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
